Small | ⭐ Review
💡 This review uniquely consolidates recent progress in high-entropy Li-rich cathodes, addressing gaps in design principles, entropy-driven mechanisms, and structure–performance relationships. It highlights emerging strategies like multi-element doping, entropy-assisted surface engineering, and machine learning acceleration, positioning entropy engineering as a general paradigm for next-generation high-energy-density lithium-ion batteries.
